output.summary: A deciduous shrub or small tree native to Mexico, Central America, Colombia and Venezuela, it has a thick succulent trunk and blunt, brittle branches. Its strongly fragrant pink, white or yellow flowers appear at branch tips, while broken branches release white latex that can irritate skin and mucous membranes.
output.edibilityNote: Despite a general poison warning, flowers are reported boiled in water or juice or made into salad for traditional therapeutic uses.
